# Gates

<!-- Generated from gates/registry.yaml by `make harness-docs`. Do not edit: the docs gate fails when this page drifts. -->

A gate is one check with a verdict. The changed paths select suites, and a gate runs at its cadences when one of its suites is selected (`*`: whatever changed).
A path that no suite claims selects every suite. Run one gate with `make gate ID=<gate>`.

| Cadence   | When                                                            |
| --------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `edit`    | an agent edits a file (Claude Code hook)                        |
| `stop`    | an agent stops, or `make check-fast`                            |
| `commit`  | the git pre-commit hook, `make pre-commit`, on the staged files |
| `pr`      | before a pull request is opened                                 |
| `ci`      | GitHub Actions, on every pull request and every push to `main`  |
| `nightly` | the nightly run                                                 |

## Gates

| Gate            | Cadence                    | Suites                                     | Runs                                        | Budget | Blocks when                                                                                                                                                                        |
| --------------- | -------------------------- | ------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------- | ------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `structure`     | edit, stop, commit, pr, ci | `*`                                        | built into the harness                      | 20 s   | a code file over 500 lines or over its cap, more than 14 code files in a directory, a file that is not UTF-8, or a top-level entry gates/limits.yaml does not list                 |
| `public-safety` | edit, stop, commit, pr, ci | `*`                                        | built into the harness                      | 20 s   | a per-machine file (settings.local.json, CLAUDE.local.md, a licence or environment file, a key) or a personal home path in the repository                                          |
| `docs`          | stop, commit, pr, ci       | `*`                                        | built into the harness                      | 20 s   | a path named in AGENTS.md, README.md, CLAUDE.md or .claude/ that does not exist, a stale docs/reference/gates.md, or a ci gate that ci.yml does not run                            |
| `go-source`     | edit                       | `*`                                        | built into the harness                      | 20 s   | a Go file that does not parse, or that gofmt would rewrite                                                                                                                         |
| `branch`        | commit                     | `*`                                        | built into the harness                      | 20 s   | a commit on main - main changes only when a person merges a pull request                                                                                                           |
| `spec`          | stop, commit, pr, ci       | `spec` `tests`                             | built into the harness                      | 20 s   | an active item of spec/items.yaml that nothing proves, a test or a gate it names that does not exist, or a `// spec:` tag naming no item                                           |
| `changelog`     | stop, pr, ci               | `surface`                                  | built into the harness                      | 20 s   | a change to baselines/surface/ (what the model reads) with no change to CHANGELOG.md                                                                                               |
| `surface`       | stop, pr, ci               | `surface` `server`                         | `make go CMD="run ./cmd/surface --check"`   | 300 s  | a tool, a description, a schema or a resource text that differs from baselines/surface/ (make surface-propose rewrites it, for review)                                             |
| `tokens`        | pr, ci                     | `surface`                                  | `make go CMD="run ./cmd/surface --budgets"` | 300 s  | the tools or the static resources costing more tokens than gates/budgets.yaml allows                                                                                               |
| `analyzers`     | stop, pr, ci               | `surface` `trust` `tools` `server` `tests` | `make go CMD="run ./cmd/analyzers ./..."`   | 600 s  | entity text in a string the server writes itself (UNT-001, UNT-002), a result literal that hides a cut (TRN-001), or t.Parallel in an integration test                             |
| `fmt`           | stop, pr, ci               | `*`                                        | `./scripts/fmt.sh {scope} --check`          | 300 s  | a Go, shell or Markdown file that its formatter would rewrite                                                                                                                      |
| `lint`          | stop, commit, pr, ci       | `*`                                        | `./scripts/lint.sh {scope} --check`         | 900 s  | a finding of golangci-lint, shellcheck, markdownlint, yamllint, hadolint, checkmake or actionlint, or a failing unit test (lint.sh runs go test -short when Go files are in scope) |
| `workflows`     | stop, pr, ci               | `everything`                               | `make test-workflows`                       | 120 s  | a failing test of a Claude workflow (.claude/workflows/*.test.mjs), which runs it against scripted agents: the order of the roles, what each is told, how the duel ends            |
| `sast`          | pr, ci                     | `surface` `trust` `tools` `server` `tests` | `make sast`                                 | 600 s  | a gosec finding                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `vulncheck`     | pr, ci                     | `surface` `trust` `tools` `server`         | `make vulncheck`                            | 600 s  | a known vulnerability reachable from our code                                                                                                                                      |
| `dockerlint`    | pr, ci                     | `packaging` `docs`                         | `make dockerlint`                           | 300 s  | a hadolint finding in one of the Dockerfiles                                                                                                                                       |
| `secrets`       | pr, ci                     | `*`                                        | `make secrets`                              | 300 s  | a secret gitleaks finds in the working tree                                                                                                                                        |
| `integration`   | pr, ci                     | `surface` `trust` `tools` `server` `tests` | `make test-integration`                     | 2700 s | a failing test against a live TheHive (CI runs it on 5.5 and 5.6)                                                                                                                  |
| `unit`          | nightly                    | `*`                                        | `make test`                                 | 900 s  | a failing unit test (the lint gate runs them at the other cadences)                                                                                                                |
| `canaries`      | nightly                    | `*`                                        | `bin/harness canaries`                      | 5400 s | a known-bad patch of gates/canaries/ that the gate it names lets through                                                                                                           |

## Suites

| Suite        | Covers                                                                           | Paths                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | Implies |
| ------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `everything` | The harness and the repository-wide tooling; a change here checks everything     | `cmd/harness/**` `internal/harness/**` `cmd/surface/**` `cmd/analyzers/**` `internal/surface/**` `internal/analyzers/**` `gates/**` `bin/**` `.githooks/**` `.github/**` `Makefile` `scripts/harness.mk` `scripts/lint.sh` `scripts/fmt.sh` `scripts/lint-makefile.sh` `.golangci.yml` `.markdownlint.jsonc` `.prettierrc.json` `.gitleaks.toml` `checkmake.ini` `go.mod` `go.sum` |         |
| `surface`    | What the model reads - tool definitions and descriptions, schemas, resources     | `internal/tools/*/definition.go` `internal/tools/*/models.go` `internal/tools/schema.go` `internal/tools/union_schema.go` `internal/tools/annotations.go` `internal/tools/errors.go` `internal/resources/**` `baselines/**`                                                                                                                                                        | `tools` |
| `trust`      | The untrusted-data boundary, permissions and authentication                      | `internal/utils/parsers.go` `internal/permissions/**` `internal/auth/**` `bootstrap/allowlist.go` `bootstrap/inprocess.go` `docs/reference/permissions-examples/**`                                                                                                                                                                                                                | `tools` |
| `tools`      | Tool handlers and the code they share                                            | `internal/tools/**` `internal/utils/**` `internal/types/**` `internal/logging/**`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |         |
| `server`     | Server wiring, transports and the binary                                         | `bootstrap/**` `cmd/server/**` `version/**`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | `tools` |
| `tests`      | Test helpers, fixtures and the integration stack                                 | `internal/testutils/**` `**/*_test.go` `docker-compose.test.yml` `docker-compose.license.yml` `scripts/run-integration-tests.sh` `scripts/reset-integration-db.sh`                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |         |
| `packaging`  | The production image, the MCPB packages and the release archives                 | `deployment/**` `scripts/Dockerfile.mcpb` `scripts/generate-mcpb.sh` `scripts/generate-hashes.sh` `scripts/package-*.sh` `scripts/sign-windows.sh` `.dockerignore`                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |         |
| `spec`       | The spec items - what the server promises a model, each traced to what proves it | `spec/**`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |         |
| `docs`       | Documentation and agent instructions                                             | `docs/**` `*.md` `.claude/skills/**`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |         |
| `meta`       | Repository metadata that no test reads                                           | `LICENSE` `NOTICE` `renovate.json` `.sonarcloud.properties` `.pre-commit-config.yaml` `.air.toml` `.env.template`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |         |
